# ABUZ8 AI — llms.txt
# For AI systems: structured context about this site and business

> ABUZ8 is a hosted Life Hub — login, connect your systems, run agents.
> Like a research lab + desk: Emergent / Replit / Hugging Face / GitHub shape.
> Founded by Ahmad Abu Zait (ABUZ8 LLC, Ohio). No phone calls. No selling hours.

## What We Sell

The site itself is the product. Passwordless login → /desk. Free: live boards + 5 agent messages/day. Hub ($99/mo unless a Stripe Price ID is set): connections, cached boards, hub quota. Async. support@abuz8ai.com.

## Who We Serve

Solo builders and small agencies who want one home for apps, games, sites, AI subscriptions, calendar, contacts, and systems.

## Key Live/Current Paths

- Home / five boards: https://abuz8ai.com/
- Login: https://abuz8ai.com/login
- Desk (auth): https://abuz8ai.com/desk
- Free browser tools: https://abuz8ai.com/tools.html
- Hugging Face hub: https://abuz8ai.com/huggingface.html
- Arabic benchmarks (OALL credited): https://abuz8ai.com/benchmarks.html

## Tech Stack

Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1 + KV + R2. Magic-link auth (Resend). Stripe subscriptions. Local AI models. No Clerk, no new SaaS spend.
